create_logger_with_file: create a logger that writes debug logs to a file and info logs to the console
create_logger_console_only: create a logger that writes only to the console by passing None as the filepath
create_logger_multi_process: create a logger with a unique log file per process using the rank parameter
reset_logger_elapsed_time: reset the logger elapsed time counter by calling the reset_time method on the logger
format_log_with_elapsed: format log messages with level name, timestamp, and elapsed time using LogFormatter
